# codebase-grep

Use `rg` (ripgrep) for fast text search across a codebase.

## When to use

- Locate symbols, identifiers, error messages
- Find every call site of a function
- Surface TODOs and FIXMEs across the tree

## When NOT to use

- Regex over binary files (use `rg --binary` for that)
- Single-file edits (use your editor's search)
